messages:
Priya (Presales): Quick sync — AcmeCorp POC. They want streaming SDK + function-calls (tool calls) + structured JSON outputs. Need a short integration checklist for devs and a ballpark pricing for ~100k tokens/day. Any obvious blockers? cc @Alex W
Alex W: I can handle pricing/infra. @Jamal, can you confirm recommended SDK pattern for streaming + fncalls?
Jamal R: Recommend websocket/SSE streaming with fncall schema. Short sample: ```js
const s = client.stream({ mode: 'sse', onEvent(e){ /* handle chunk/toolcall */ } })
s.emit('init', { format: 'funcjson', maxInflight: 8 })
```
Jamal R: Auth: short-lived creds (STS) + allowlist IPs for on‑prem. For cloud hosted, ephemeral tokens + role delegation.
Priya (Presales): Do we have a one-pager for SOC2 / KMS / data residency? They specifically asked about EU residency and customer-managed keys.
Maria S: Yes — Dedicated supports EU regions and CMEK via KMS/HSM. Private deploy (VPC) supports customer-managed keys and audit trail. I can drop the runbook link here after the call.
Alex W: Pricing (ballpark): Hosted at this scale (~100k tokens/day) is usually X/day (depends on avg seq len). Dedicated reserved capacity reduces unit cost — need expected QPS and avg seq length to firm up. Priya, can you capture concurrency + avg and 95p latency SLO?
Priya (Presales): Will ask Acme for concurrency and avg seq len. Also, they sent a security questionnaire asking about key rotation and data retention windows.
Jamal R: For integration gotcha: their gateway rewrites headers and drops `x-client-id`. SDK handshake expects either header or pre-shared `client_id` param. If gateway strips headers, require header passthrough or map into query param at edge. Also backpressure: set `maxInflight=8` and `ack` on tool responses.
Alex W: Potential enterprise blocker: they want guaranteed 99.9% latency under burst. Dedicated + autoscale burst helps, but we need upfront commit for predictable throughput.
Maria S: For structured tool output recommend schema v2: fields `tool_id`, `confidence`, `payload` (JSON). Example: { "tool_id": "lookup_customer", "confidence": 0.97, "payload": { ... } }.
SDK-Bot: New sample created: https://git.internal/sdk-samples/acme-streaming (private). Includes SSE + fncall example and handshake notes.
Alex W: Next steps: Priya to collect concurrency, avg seq len, and completed security form. Jamal to prep a 10–15 min demo snippet and a 1-page runbook for onprem handshake. I'll prepare cost ranges (hosted vs dedicated vs private).
Priya (Presales): Thanks — will follow up in tomorrow's presales call. /remind me in 1 day Follow-up: Acme POC (collect concurrency + security form)
Alex W: :thumbsup:
Maria S: I'll attach the SOC2/KMS brief when I have it ready.
